newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish printer Poligrafia IPO quickly subscribed.
newsitem.headline: Polish printer Poligrafia IPO quickly subscribed.

text.p: The 500,000-share initial public offering of Polish printing house Poligrafia SA to small investors was fully subscribed in 90 minutes, an official from issue manager IB Austria Securities said on Tuesday.

"Within an hour and a half the whole 500,000-share tranche was subscribed...and we expect Poligrafia's (next) tranche for larger investors to be subscribed to in a similar fashion," primary markets director Ryszard Jach told Reuters.
The small investor tranche, which had been set for November 4 to November 8, will be followed by an 857,280-share large investor tranche from November 12 to November 15.
Shares in both phases of the ex-rights issue are going for 7.5 zlotys each.
Jach said Poligrafia's solid fundamentals and low number of shares had created the large demand for the issue.
Poligrafia, which will be traded on the Warsaw bourse's parallel market, is 88.8-percent owned by Polish construction company Exbud SA.
